SELECT tu.*,COALESCE(t_order_num.access_num,0) as access_num from t_user tu left join (select lawyer_user_id,count(id) as access_num from t_order to2 where status in(2,3) group by lawyer_user_id) as t_order_num on tu.id = t_order_num.lawyer_user_id
and tu.account like concat('%',#{param2.account},'%')
and tu.role_id = #{param2.roleId}
and tu.user_name like concat('%',#{param2.userName},'%')
order by access_num desc
